review: N Faust is an ID that's really good with supporting other units by giving the Gaze debuff. If ran on a team that has a lot of lust, she can also support by providing a teamwide SP heal. Outside of that there's nothing significant with N Faust. Notable E.G.O Synergies: Hex Nail - N Corp Faust fuels Hex Nail nicely and this + Gaze can be a lot of damage boost in a proper team. Fluid Sac - N Corp Faust fuels this E.G.O. partially which makes it available for use more often.
